Three separate Q/K/V exchanges incur three startups; no fused QKV communication or zero-cost packing is claimed.
Whole local payload includes the self block; an explicit pairwise factor (P-1)/P accounts for remote bytes once, with P-1 startup rounds.
Separate source/destination buffers are allocated; zero extra transport workspace is an explicit ideal-buffer assumption. Local communication HBM is unknown.
All rates, capacity, efficiency, softmax operation proxy and full FP32 scratch below are artificial author declarations, not sourced benchmarks.
Dense unmasked attention on the current prefill sequence only; no KV cache, causal mask, RoPE, norm, MLP, backward or optimizer. Past context must be zero.
All three group names reuse the identical physical members.

Global serial-barrier policy: devices within one logical node start together; the next logical node waits for the slowest participating device. No inter-node overlap.
Compute ready-node ties follow expanded graph order. Communication ties use stable node IDs; explicit and inferred data dependencies take priority.
External graph inputs, weights and initialized states are available in their explicitly declared initial layouts. Load/conversion time is outside this phase.
Legacy communications without placement are not silently appended to the timeline. Unknown durations or data readiness stop absolute timestamps, while known per-step durations remain visible.
